options.label: Passive Resistance, 100%
options.rule:
Use "Unlock all content" option to unlock all difficulties and all levels.

- Hardest difficulty (Nasty) must be selected.
- Passive Resistance quest must be passed (no enemies harmed, no death on Level 1 Area 1).
- All other areas must be passed for 100% overall evaluation (all enemies destroyed).
- Deathless.
